global.title: More than 600 soldiers join Army's new space operations career field
global.summary: WASHINGTON — More than 600 soldiers have joined the Army’s new space operations career field, giving the service its first permanent enlisted workforce dedicated to the space domain.
global.why: Kept so the editor has a record of what was reported, not because a full desk sweep was done.

global.title: Army awards $67 million for technologies to counter space-enabled surveillance
global.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Army is putting nearly $67 million into electromagnetic warfare prototype systems that would make it harder for adversaries to use space-based surveillance to find and target American forces.
